text:
Marta: Non-work drop 30 Chewie the corgi staged a daring escape from the conference chair and now refuses to return without an audience. video (tiny): https://imgur.com/a/placeholder :dog: :rolling_eyes:
Omar: Did chewie master wheel navigation or is this a bribery situation? :joy:
Priya: If there is an audience, chewie will accept applause in the form of treats. tried and tested. :tada:
Jin: That swivel chair looks like a throne. call security (aka Eli) to escort the monarch back to the rug :crown:
Eli: I attempted negotiation. offered a squeaky toy and a donut crumb. chewie accepted the toy but kept the donut crumbs for later. will attempt gentle retrieval in 5.
Zara: Will there be a coronation ceremony? i can craft a tiny sash out of a sticky note. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Marta: Vote: sash color — yellow (energizing) vs teal (very regal) vs confetti (chaotic).
Omar: confetti is chewies brand. democracy for the donut crumbs.
Priya: teal for photos, confetti for content. i pick teal.
Jin: metadata: chair rotation speed = alarming. footage includes a dramatic slow-turn at timestamp 0:03. :film_projector:
cam-bot: uploaded video: chewie-chair-escape.mp4 (file)
Eli: retrieval success. chewie surrendered after a tickle behind the left ear. sash (teal) applied. hero shot incoming. :camera_with_flash:
Marta: posting hero shot to #pets-album and tagging HQ socials (if chewie consents). big thanks team, that was the morale boost i needed today. :heart:
